items.title: Solana’s Alpenglow, its biggest network overhaul since 2020, goes live Wednesday
items.summary: Alpenglow will replace the voting system Solana has used since 2020, targeting roughly 150-millisecond finality after months of testing that included a failed migration and rollback.

items.title: MoonPay, Upbit parent Dunamu explore collaboration on stablecoin payments, GIWA expansion
items.summary: The companies also plan to explore ways to broaden global access to Dunamu's Ethereum Layer 2, GIWA chain.

items.title: Musk says SpaceX-Tesla merger a ‘good idea’ as AI revenue jumps ninefold
items.summary: A merger would bring Tesla into the same corporate group as Grok developer SpaceXAI and social media platform X.

items.title: Pendle Daily Volume Hits $159 Million, Led by Ethereum
items.summary: Ethereum accounted for $121.5 million of trading, while the protocol's locked value rose only modestly during the day.
